higgsino.verdict: with M_SS = 8.45e9 the splitting is ~1 keV, so the higgsino stays Dirac-like and must be heavier than ~8e10 GeV, i.e. mu ~ 10 M_SS; then it is not the LSP. The hybrid's DM must be a bino/gaugino-type LSP at ~M_SS produced by freeze-in (T_RH < M_SS), or an axion

z3.statement: E6's centre Z3 and trinification's cyclic Z3 are both elements of E6 (the cyclic permutation is a Weyl-group element), so every E6-invariant operator is invariant under them: neither can forbid Hbar Sigma^2 H. 'Ternary' structures inside E6 cannot protect the accidental symmetry; a symmetry outside E6 (Pass 12718's Z10) is needed

requirements: radial potential quadratic-dominated along a flat direction (W = lambda X (P Q - f_a^2) with soft masses)
resonance parameter q = g^2 Phi_0^2 / 4 m^2 <~ 1 for couplings to the axion and other fields
saxion decays before BBN without restoring PQ
pq_relaxation.note: a pure lambda |Phi|^4 radial potential restores PQ for Phi_0/f_a ~ 7e6 (conformal preheating); a SUSY flat direction is required
